race.comment: THE GREY ONE (1) has made a bright start to his career, charging home for second on debut before winning with a fair bit up his sleeve at the Gold Coast last time. Looks better the further he stretches, so expecting him to relish the mile. SPIRIT OF TORQUE (4) looks the main danger after thrashing his rivals over a similar trip here last time to shed the maiden tag. Have to consider. VIENI QUA (6) is another who got off the mark in dominant fashion last time, though will need to convert that form to the turf. WORTHTHEADMISSION (8) is another last start winner, leading all of the way at Casino. This is tougher but expecting her to give backers another sight, and could hold on for a minor spot at big odds. FEARLESS WIN (3) has been below her best since resuming but strips fitter third-up and gets a key booking in Maloney. Could sneak a minor slot.
